output: LoRA fine-tuning keeps the original model frozen and learns small low-rank adapter weights, so you adapt the model with far fewer parameters and memory.
Imagine a big robot brain. Instead of rebuilding the whole thing to teach it new tricks, we snap on tiny helper pieces that show it what to do. Those helpers are LoRA adapters.

instruction: Give two examples where LoRA is useful.
